scope: v4 space flight and docked orbital liaison only. Original bar/back-room/bodyguard/planetary assault purposes and all source landing paths reference-only. Frontier/Operations remain excluded.

playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_known_2a: At Edzaar main orbital station, you and Cherkasova open a secure liaison with Alsto Abonlo. You explain that he previously supplied information about SDF dealings, but you did not complete an assisted interception with him. Your GalCop affiliation may now make the discussion difficult.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_known_2b: You identify yourself as a GalCop officer and introduce Major Cherkasova. You challenge Abonlo about a suspected Sirius Defence Force alliance and plans against Maenes' orbital facilities. He suggests that even if the League lost a battle, Sirius would ensure it won the wider conflict. He presents the removal of government control as the League's aim.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_helped_2a: At Edzaar main orbital station, you and Cherkasova contact Abonlo. Your earlier assisted convoy interception makes him a familiar but compromised contact. You suspect he may have profited further from the captured craft; their resale remains a suspicion. This time you will reveal your GalCop affiliation.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_helped_2b: Abonlo recognises you as GalCop's operative. Cherkasova challenges his arrangement with Sirius and the suspected Maenes operation. He replies that Sirius would back the League even if it lost an initial battle. He says the League intends to dismantle government control.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_unknown_2a: At Edzaar main orbital station, you and Cherkasova establish your first secure liaison with pirate commander Alsto Abonlo. Your briefing describes his influence within the League of Anarchists and warns that he is unlikely to yield easily.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_unknown_2b: You present your GalCop credentials and introduce Cherkasova. You challenge Abonlo about the suspected SDF alliance and planned action against Maenes' orbital facilities. He dismisses your warning and suggests Sirius would back the League in a wider conflict. He describes the League's ambition to remove government control.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_2c: Abonlo claims Sirius would leave the League alone so long as its business continued. Cherkasova presents an alleged SDF order to eliminate him, hoping to split the alliance. He calls it KSR disinformation. When she threatens action against the Edzaar squadrons, he ends the secure call. The alleged order is not verified evidence.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_2d: After the call, Cherkasova admits that the termination order was fabricated as a bluff. Naval command then reports its forces ready for action. Her government has authorised an attack on the pirate fleet. Prepare to launch together and assist the Navy against the ten designated Python cruisers.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_4a: At Arenxeon main orbital station, Cherkasova reviews the destruction of all ten designated Python cruisers. The surviving smaller ships no longer form the League's organised cruiser fleet; their actual engines and capabilities remain their own. Sirius' response is still uncertain. The Navy is resupplying in the sector while KSR signals posts monitor Sirius communications.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_4b: Through the orbital liaison you report the Edzaar action to Admiral Ibanez. He explains that the Soviet pre-emptive strike has divided the Security Council, though the evidence of an alliance supports the concern about Maenes. Stay available for further instructions while GalCop and KSR watch for Sirius' response.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_5: An urgent GalCop report reaches your docked ship at {notification_station_name}. KSR signals intelligence intercepted a priority Sirius instruction: INITIATE IRON RAVEN ALPHA, IMMEDIATE. Ibanez believes it orders an attack on Maenes' orbital facilities. Task Force Juliet is responding. Proceed to Maenes; Cherkasova is assigned to liaise there. This message supplies the next lead, not a completed battle.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_brief_1: Meet Cherkasova at Edzaar main orbital station and contact Abonlo.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_brief_2: Assist the Soviet Navy against the ten designated Python cruisers. Destroyed hulls, not recovered escape pods, count towards this objective.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_brief_3: Travel with Cherkasova and regroup at Arenxeon main orbital station.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_brief_4: Proceed to Maenes for the orbital defence operation.
playable_text_overrides.IR_waitforinfo_brief: Await GalCop's next intelligence report while docked at a main orbital station in Galaxy 8.
playable_text_overrides.IR_python_cruisers: Zarya-1: ten designated Python cruisers must be destroyed. Escorts and unrelated ships are separate targets.
playable_text_overrides.IR_anarchist_comm: Zarya-1: all ten designated Python cruisers are destroyed. Regroup at Arenxeon main orbital station.
